# Loot

> Weighted drop tables with saved pity.

- Package: `Loot` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Codex](Codex.md), [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Loot")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Loot")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Loot`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/LootService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Loot = GaxiaServer.Loot
```

### Functions

- `Loot.PickWeighted(weights: { number }, roll01: number): number`
  ── PURE: pick an index from weights given a roll in [0,1) (seed-testable) ──
- `Loot.DefineTable(tableId: string, entries: { LootEntry }): ()`
- `Loot.GetTable(tableId: string): { LootEntry }?`
- `Loot.GetDropRates(tableId: string): { [string]: number }`
  Honest base odds (item → probability 0..1) from the weights. Pity is a separate guarantee on top, not folded into these numbers.
- `Loot.GetPity(player: Player, tableId: string, item: string): number`
- `Loot.Roll(player: Player, tableId: string): Drop?`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Loot.OnDrop` — `Signal<Player, string, string, boolean>`
  (player, tableId, item, viaPity) after every successful Roll

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).
